UPDATE build SET category = ?, width = ?, orientation = ?,
            encoding = ?, latency = ?, synchronized = ?, design = ?,
            built_on = ?, description = ?, logic = ?, throughput = ?,
            at_least = ?, pulse = ?, unverified = ?,
            edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
         WHERE id = ?
